note: Ped/vehicle spawns, firefight, scripted escape. Built.
Freeway intercept on live traffic AI. Built.
Uncoupling a 40-car freight train is not exposed to script. Freeze a train at a junction and blip it as "blockade"; the depot raid and hauler defence are Green.
Garage firefight plus subway pursuit. Trains on the line are a hazard, not a system.
Sea-cave interior needs an MLO or a substitute (existing Paleto cave). Cliff sniping, flare drops and the boat chase are Green.
Depot breach, alley hold, reverse extraction. Interior is an MLO or a walled-off exterior yard.
Climbing a mast has no animation set; use a ladder-and-teleport with a camera cut. Drone is a Buzzard at altitude. BASE jump is Green.
Forklift is drivable; crate load is a hold-zone objective plus a prop attach.
Landing skids on a moving truck roof is unreliable physics. Slow the convoy to a stop off-camera, or attach the heli to the truck for the beat.
Escort with a speed floor, RPG from the bed, PIT manoeuvres. The campaign's best Green set piece.
Static workshop scene; dyno is a UI meter over a frozen vehicle.
ROV drone: use a submersible with a locked camera, or a camera-only "drone mode" with no vehicle at all.
Limpet charges on boats, then detonate. Straight explosive work.
Hangar theft and a low-altitude run. SAMs are scripted rockets from fixed points.
Maintenance vault interior needs an MLO; the tranquilliser takedowns and splice are Green.
Zancudo is already hostile territory; Cargobob theft is stock.
Static customisation scene, same pattern as M11.
Staging: park three vehicles, play the countdown speech.
Underwater cutting: hold-zone objective with particle effects. Container "rising" is a spawned prop moved on a curve.
Cargobob winch on a 30-ton container under AA fire. The winch works; the weight does not. Attach the container to the heli and script the flight path with the player in gunner role.
Boat escort with flares and hostile launches.
Container drop is a prop teleport. The cruise-missile strike on the foundry is a cutscene: fade, explosion, smoke column prop.
Bunker clear-out. Interior is an MLO or the existing Senora structures.
Crane dredging: hold-zone plus a prop rising out of the water on a timer.
Bridge sniping and a river extraction.
Duster dogfight; weaponised biplanes exist in stock content.

Plane-to-plane boarding at 8,000 ft with zero-G interior combat. Fake in three cuts: matched flight (attach player plane to the jet's path), a cut to a static interior standing in for the cabin, then a scripted bail-out. Do not attempt physical zero-G AI.
Tower climb and EMP splice; same ladder-and-cut technique as M07.
Truck onto a moving flatbed: freeze the train at speed 0 with a moving-camera illusion, or attach the truck once it is close.
Downhill trophy-truck run under helicopter fire.
Mines and turrets: proximity checks plus scripted explosions. CIWS is a scripted turret.
Underwater intake infiltration needs an interior; the warhead cases are props.
Salt-flat ambush and rescue. Smoke is a particle effect.
Sandstorm escort with a turret. Weather is settable; the rockslide is a scripted explosion plus prop swap.
Convoy ambush in a pass. Stock vehicles throughout.
Sub recon: same drone treatment as M12.
Aircraft theft and retrofit; retrofit is a static scene.
Quarry firefight using haulers as cover.
Deep-water cable cutting: hold-zone at depth with limited air as the tension.
Static boat-armouring scene.
Lodge infiltration in a blizzard. Weather is settable.
Air-dropping a submarine from a Titan. Fake it: cargo ramp cutscene, cut to the sub already under parachutes, splashdown spawn.
Staging scene.
Underwater charges on rig pylons; the rig itself needs a prop or an existing platform.
Helipad drop in a storm onto a structure that has to exist first. Everything above deck is Green once it does.
Vault interior — MLO or a substitute interior.

A collapsing, tilting rig. GTA V cannot deform a structure. Do it with a camera-shaken fade, swap to a pre-damaged version of the prop, and put the player in a BASE jump before the "collapse" resolves.
Highway blockade breakout.
Checkpoint ram with tower sniping.
Archive interior needs an MLO; the sentry takedowns and the wipe are Green.
Transformer yard sabotage; the blackout is a scripted light change over Downtown.
Rooftop sniper shot on a scripted walk path, then a bike escape.
Subway tunnel ambush with mines and night vision.
Penthouse interior — MLO. The balcony roost and antenna are dressing.

Three simultaneous penthouse breaches on a 300-second clock. This is the mission the whole switch system exists for, and it is worth building properly: three separate spawn sets, one shared timer, forced switching between them. Interiors can be substituted, the mechanic cannot.
Canal armour clash. The aqueduct is one of the best drivable spaces in the game.
Jet-ski anti-air run.
Compound assault in Mirror Park.
Radio-mast climb and broadcast, with sniper cover on the Vinewood sign.
Neighbourhood defence in waves. Reuses SurviveWavesObjective wholesale.
Flooded gunship interior needs a wreck prop; the underwater fight is Green.
Train, boat and helicopter converging with a sling-load pickup. Build it as three scripted lanes with forced switches; the container hook is an attach, not a physics winch.
Lobby breach by ramming. Maze Bank's ground floor is enterable.
Elevator-shaft ascent with falling cars. Stairwell fights are Green; the falling car is a scripted prop on a path.
Boardroom confrontation needs the top-floor interior (an MLO exists in some map packs).
Antenna BASE jump into a storm. Stock parachute mechanics.
Dialogue scene inside a moving truck.
18-wheeler running battle in the canal with a roof turret.
Runway rampage dodging landing airliners. Spawn planes on scripted approach paths rather than relying on ambient air traffic.
Cargo-plane siege ending with a taxi off the seawall into the ocean. Waves and the holdout are Green; the seawall launch is a scripted vehicle path plus a camera cut into the water.
Warehouse assault. Built.
Server annex interior; laser sweeps are scripted trigger volumes with a visual effect.
Street race under the freeway. Uses RaceCheckpointObjective.
Counter-sniper duel in open terrain. Ideal Ice showcase, no interiors needed.
Swamp kayak and dive; the buoy is a prop, the splice a hold-zone.
Canyon fuel-tanker run under bike attack.
Hotel suite interior — MLO or a substitute. The floor-by-floor fight is Green.
Office tower interior; the incendiary burn is a particle-and-fade sequence.
Impound theft, five-star pursuit, container delivery.
